result.summary: The page is mostly intact. The only noticeable visual issue is an inconsistent overlay position on one restaurant card in the horizontal carousel. The partially clipped carousel item and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scrolling/viewport behavior and are not reported as defects.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the delivery-time badge on the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is positioned at the bottom-left, while the other cards have the badge at the top-left.
issues.suggestion: Align all delivery-time badges to the same corner, preferably top-left, to maintain visual consistency across the carousel.
